descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Your shift starts now.

THE CRUISER
A real patrol-car interior built for VR: steering wheel, working gauges, radar head, light bar and siren switches, and an MDT laptop on the console. Grip the wheel with your own hands or drive with the sticks.

INTERSTATE 7
Free patrol on a highway loop through Cedar Valley with traffic, ramps, overpasses and shoulders - at noon, at dusk and after dark with the strobes lighting the road.

TRAFFIC STOPS
The radar clocks every car ahead. Pull in behind, hit the lights, and the driver pulls to the shoulder. Step out, walk up to the window, talk to the driver, take the licence and run the plate on the MDT. Warn them, write the ticket, or make the arrest.

PURSUITS AND FELONY STOPS
Some drivers run. Stay on them with the siren going until they give up, then order them out, hands up, on their knees, and cuff them.

SHOTS FIRED
Dispatch sends you to armed suspects on the shoulder, and some stops turn dangerous. Draw from the circle menu and defend yourself.

YOUR PARTNER
A partner rides with you, calls out the radar, covers you on a stop, and keeps up small talk between calls.

A CAREER
Eight missions from a first speeder to armed-and-dangerous, a score for every stop, and a night shift that pays more.
